notes.title: P.19.2 | Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New :

 Added a "Game" tab in the settings menu
 Added a new option in the "Game" tab to change how doors interact with the player :

 Manual (default)
 Close Automatically
 Open/Close Automatically



Changes :

 Updated all the on-screen buttons with custom buttons
 During the door open/close animation, the player will no longer get pushed by the doors
 Updated the open/close animation
 Added new doors around the shop
 Added signs around the shop
 Added stuff to the bathroom
 Added placeholder pictures for the paintings


Bug Fixes :

 Fixed a bug that could crash that game when the player interacts with the register when there's no orders
 Fixed an issue that caused the parking spots to have physical hitbboxes
 Fixed a bug that caused multiple cars to take the same parking spots
 Added a fix to the AI script to try to fix customers randomly teleporting out of the cafe when their order is complete
 Fixed a bug that caused the player to get stuck on nothing in the backroom
 Fixed a bug where if the player hit escape/start while having the "confirm purchase" screen up, would cause close the shop screen, but force the confirm purchase screen open and would lock-up the player
 Fixed a bug where hitting escape/start wouldn't close the "Confirm Purchase" screen

notes.title: P.17.0 | Gameplay Overhaul #1
notes.content:
New :
Rating System :
This is the first iteration of the rating system, you'll be rating on a scale of 0 to 100, depending on how correct the order is, you'll be rated, and your café rating will be affected depending on the total ratings given!
Coffees :

 Iced Coffee, and any items relating to it!


Changes :
Shop :

 Adjusted the position of the counters
 Adjusted the colors of the inner walls
 Added some additional counter space
 Resized the desk in the office
 Doors now have a hitbox, and must be interacted with to open and closed
 Customers will now automatically open and close the front door

Customers :

 Customers will now order iced coffee
 If a customer's order is not completed, they will now give a raiting of 0.5 stars
 The rate that customers spawn will now be based off of your rating and how many customers have been served
 Adjusted spawn timer for a chance to spawn a customer to now be based of difficulty :

 Easy : 30s
 Normal (default) : 25s
 Hard : 20s

 Adjusted change to spawn customer based on difficulty :

 Easy : 50% 
 Normal  : 70%
 Hard : 85% (was default)

 Adjusted Customer Personalities

 Rushed :

 Wait timer increased : 30s -> 35s
 Order wait timer decreased : 40s -> 35s
 Adjusted rates of ordering food : 1 [60%], 2 [15%] -> 1 [30%], 2[5%]

 New Customer :

 Order wait timer decreased : 70s -> 55s
 Adjusted rates of ordering additional coffee : 2 [10%], 3 [1%] -> 2 [15%], 3 [0%]
 Adjusted rates of ordering food : 1 [30%], 2 [10%] -> 1 [40%], 2 [5%]

 Chill :

 Wait timer decreased : 100s -> 90s
 Order wait timer decreased : 100s -> 90s
 Adjusted rates of ordering additional coffee : 2 [50%], 3 [25%] -> 2 [40%], 3 [15%], 4 [3%]
 Adjusted rates of ordering food : 1 [95%], 2 [45%], 3 [20%] -> 1 [100%], 2 [35%], 3 [5%]

 Normal :

 Adjusted rates of ordering additional coffee : 2 [35%] -> 2 [30%]
 Adjusted rates of ordering food : 1 [100%], 2 [15%] -> 1 [85%], 2 [15%]


MixMaster Shop :

 Added a confirm purchase screen
This new addition will give some feedback to make sure the player knows when they bought something
 The player can now only have a maximum of 24 boxes in the drop off zone



Bug Fixes :

 Fixed a bug where customers wouldn't penalize the player for giving them the wrong food
 Fixed a bug with the outline script that caused outlines to stay, even when the player isn't looking at it
 Fixed a bug with the item overlay with the held item disappearing after looking at a different object
 Fixed an issue with the grass texture, which caused it to have a weird glossy visual

notes.title: P.16.2 | Quality of Life & Bug Fixes #2
notes.content:
New :
System :

On-Screen Prompts | V1
In-game, you will now see buttons you can press depending on what you're looking at, and if you're holding something!


Changes :
Main Menu :

 The controls screen will now show the controls for whatever input you're using

System :

 Adjusted the lighting system


Bug Fixes :

 Fixed a bug with walking SFX not playing even when the player is moving

notes.title: P.16.1 | Quality of Life & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
New :
Settings :

Added a controller type setting :
This new setting will allow you to pick from the following controller types

 Xbox (Default)
 Playstation
 Nintendo Switch


Changes :
Controllers :

Changed Binds (Xbox Controls used as Example)

 Confirm : B -> A
 Back : A -> B
 Crouch : Right Shoulder Button -> Click in Right Stick

This should help make playing on controller feel less clunky!

Player :

Movement Speed :

 Decreased base move speed : 15 -> 14
 Increased bonus sprint speed : 11 -> 13

Sprinting :

  You no longer have to hold the sprint button to run, it now works like a toggle

Crouching :

  You no longer have to hold the crouch button to crouch, it now works like a toggle

These last two changes will make sprinting and crouching much more usable on controller!


Bug Fixes : 

 Fixed an issue that displayed the controller prompts at the main menu even if the player isn't using controller
 Fixed a bug when using a controller in the settings menu, it would default to the fullscreen button, which is disabled
 Fixed missing and incorrect bindings shown in the controls menu
 Fixed a bug when standing still with a controller would still cause the walking SFX to continuously play
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to forget if the player was using a controller or not between the main menu and the game

notes.title: P.16.0 | MixMaster Update
notes.content:
New  :

Features :

 MixMaster Shop :

The MixMaster shop is now available to be accessed through the computer in the back office! This brand new shop will allow the player to order goods from coffee cups and lids, coffee grinds and flavor pumps, and even machines! After ordering an item, it'll delivered outside at the back of the café! Listed below are items that are available to purchase in this update!
 Coffee items :

 Stacks of Coffee Cups
 Stacks of Coffee Lids
 Coffee Grinds
 Flavor Pumps

 Machines :

 Coffee Maker
 Coffee Pot
 Measuring Cup

 Food :

 Bagels
 Donuts
 Chocolate Chip Muffins
 Chocolate Muffins


 Shop Sign :

Players now have a shop sign in the front window! They can interact with it top open and close the shop! Allowing players to have a chance to prepare before opening up the café!


Systems :

 Implemented a loading screen
 Added full controller support
 Some menus will have on-screen prompts for controller
 Adjusted the in-game lighting and fog to make the game brighter, and let the player see more

Customers :

 The game will now spawn male and female customers
 There are a total of 6 of variations of sprites on each gender
 Customer Timers will now only show if the timers are active

Boxes :

 Will now label how many of the item are left in each box



Changes :

Main Menu :

 Updated the design of the Main Menu

Systems :

 Changed the PixelRift Studios intro card when starting the game
Controller :

 Increased base sens : 150 -> 200


Player :

 Increased base movespeed : 11 -> 15

Customers : 

 Optimized all of the customer scripts to make them run smoother
 Reduced max amount of customers that can wait for orders : 4 -> 3
This change is to help with customers getting stuck and breaking

Shop : 

 Adjusted the sink hitbox to help try to prevent accidental activations : Entire counter + faucet -> faucet
 Shifted the position of the dumpsters in the back
 Adjusted the entire environment around the shop
 Removed the 6 coffee grinds bags from the back of the shop

Item : 

 Boxes :

 Boxes can now only be thrown away in the dumpsters out back

 Updated the Coffee Grinds Bag Model & Texture



Bug Fixes :

 Fixed a bug with the timer of customers refilling even if they didnt move
 Fixed a bug with customers walking in place in line
 Fixed a bug with the customer movement script spitting out overflow errors
 Fixed a bug that caused customers to spit out random errors when spawned
 Fixed a clipping issue with boxes
 Fixed issues that caused a bunch of errors with the Rigidbody component
 Fixed a bug when you grab a coffee maker while there's a coffee pot in it, the coffee pot wouldn't follow the coffee maker
 Fixed a bug with the outline script that sometimes caused it to break when switching between objects quickly
 Fixed a bug with the indicators for the coffee maker layering behind the glass when placed infront of the windows
 Fixed a bug with interior walls being the incorrect color

This issue will take a little longer, due to us having to rework how collision works between items and walls
